title: StyleStill: cover art for every look, motion style and caption style, a shop window he picks from
goal:
Krish, 16 Nov 2026: "I should be showing shop window examples of how that element looks"; "what cover art would you use to represent that entire motion style, so someone is inspired to pick it from a lineup?" The board's pickers show one still per option, side by side. Each still is that style's cover: the style at its very best, so he wants to pick it.

Build a Remotion composition `StyleStill`, 1080x1920, one frame, in apps/renderer/src/engine/stills/, registered in apps/renderer/src/Root.tsx. Props: {layer: 'treatment' | 'motion' | 'captions', id: string}. Every cover shares one lineup frame (the design lock's canvas and zones, the brand tokens, the style's name small at the foot) so covers read as a set, and inside it the style's own signature dominates: its device and moment of motion (config/ve/devices.json, the module's ve_route), its colours, type and caption treatment.

Subjects come from the work he praised, never invented filler and never placeholder words: "I got great feedback on the production standards, and the script for the AI music video (the Rat Tails video), and the characters of the AI video". Use the beats, numbers and lines of the Wed 11 AI music piece (docs/plans/2026-11-11-wednesday) and the Fri 13 Rat Tails piece (docs/plans/2026-11-09-week/fri-preproduction, docs/plans/2026-11-13-friday), and his drawn character (config/ve/character.json) where a person belongs. The three styles measured from his own cuts (docs/ve/styles/*.card.json) are drawn exactly as measured.
- motion: the style's most telling frame on one of those beats;
- captions: the caption theme (captions/names.ts CAPTION_THEMES) on a line from those scripts;
- treatment (looks, config/style-references.json formats.production): the look's layout from its modules on one of those beats.
Export `stillIds()` listing every {layer, id} it draws; draw null for one it cannot, so the list says which.
read: apps/renderer/src/engine/**, apps/renderer/src/Root.tsx, config/ve/design-lock.json, config/ve/brand-tokens.json, config/ve/devices.json, config/ve/character.json, config/style-references.json, config/caption-themes.json, config/brand-palette.json, docs/ve/styles/**, docs/plans/2026-11-11-wednesday/**, docs/plans/2026-11-09-week/fri-preproduction/**, docs/plans/2026-11-13-friday/**, docs/ve/MOTION_STANDARD.md, docs/ve/INGREDIENTS.md
contract: Never use or read anything of the Thu 5 Nov No Spending piece (docs/plans/2026-11-05-thursday-no-spending, its take or its frames): he rejected it and it is never an example. No photograph, recording or real face: drawn only, his drawn character allowed. One clock (useCurrentFrame only in apps/renderer/src/engine/clock.ts). Pure functions of props, no Math.random, no wall clock, no network, no media files. Colour roles from tokens, never raw hex. Type roles from the design lock. Reuse the library devices and caption themes as they are; never fork one.
